label: Measurable quantity and unit
definition: A property represented by a numerical value relative to a defined reference unit under a measurement procedure.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate synthesis requiring accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Measurement scale type
definition: A nominal, ordinal, interval, ratio, logarithmic, or other declared scale whose permissible comparisons and transformations differ.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate synthesis requiring accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: SI quantity and unit coherence
definition: The SI defines units through fixed constants and coherent derived relations; quantity equations and unit symbols obey conventions distinct from numerical value.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate synthesis requiring accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Instrument scale and unit expression
definition: Instrument readings, calibration marks, quantity values, unit symbols, and scale transformations representing measurement results.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate synthesis requiring accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Identify and represent measurement
definition: Within Measurable Attributes, Units, and Scales, this family groups bounded performances under the shared purpose "Identify and represent measurement": Identify a measurable attribute; Read a calibrated scale.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate synthesis requiring accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Identify a measurable attribute
definition: Given an object, event, or process and a question, distinguish the target measurable attribute from the object and select an operationally meaningful quantity.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate synthesis requiring accountable mathematical and educational review.
capability_statement: Given an object, event, or process and a question, distinguish the target measurable attribute from the object and select an operationally meaningful quantity.

label: Read a calibrated scale

capability_statement: Given a calibrated analog or digital representation, determine the indicated value with unit, sign, resolution-aware precision, and stated interpolation convention.

capability_statement: Given values on a declared scale type, determine which differences, ratios, orderings, or averages are meaningful and justify from permissible transformations.

label: Geometric measure
definition: A length, angle, area, surface area, or volume assigned to a geometric object under declared metric and unit conventions.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate synthesis requiring accountable mathematical and educational review.

review_notes: AI-assisted candidate synthesis requiring accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Geometric measure formulas and scaling
definition: Measure formulas follow from definitions or decompositions, and uniform scaling by a factor changes lengths, areas, and volumes by first, second, and third powers.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate synthesis requiring accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Dimensioned geometric diagram
definition: A diagram, net, coordinate model, or dissection with labeled dimensions, angles, units, and decomposition boundaries.
review_notes: AI-assisted candidate synthesis requiring accountable mathematical and educational review.

capability_statement: Given a calibrated representation, coordinates, or sufficient exact relations, determine a length or angle with appropriate units and precision.

label: Derived quantity

review_notes: AI-assisted candidate synthesis requiring accountable mathematical and educational review.

label: Compound-unit table and formula

capability_statement: Given compatible component quantities and a declared relation, compute the derived quantity, preserve unit algebra, and state zero-denominator or domain restrictions.
